title: IdentityAccountCreatedV1
description: An account was created: `completeSignUp` accepted the birth year at the age gate (phase P03 §7, doc 06 §4). Producer `identity`; aggregate `user` with the account's `usr_` id; `subjectUserId` is that id. Ids and timestamps only, never an email, name or birth year (doc 06 §6, doc 11 §6). The full event is the envelope (envelope.json) narrowed by this schema; the payload is open content, so consumers ignore properties they do not know (doc 06 §4).

userId.description: The new account, a prefixed ULID (`usr_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.user`); the API's `UserId`
